display_map_unresolved.description: The display adapter cannot map a frame, a region or an input box of a task package onto the delivered frame (Workflow #392, model 392 v1.2 §9.1); display_problem says why. As a run's end it is decidable without the screen and leaves the run with no input: no declaration where one is needed (layout_undeclared), a device smaller than the base (scale_below_base), a box with no size left (collapsed), a box wholly outside the frame (outside_frame), or a positional box across a third line under a translation without an anchor (straddles_zones). Workflow #392 DA-2a: the kernel's frame gate (every frame a run recognises, at stage display_map_build) admits only the identity and a pure scale and refuses a translation or a cropped frame as translation_unsupported until DA-2b, and a frame of the package's other orientation as orientation_mismatch (only a cause from DA-2b on); the host's input prerequisite refuses an input on a frame that is not the plain identity as input_scale_unsupported (stage display_input_map) until DA-3. It replaces the retired contained_task_frame_resolution_mismatch. Ends only that run, never the Runtime.

display_map_stale.description: The display geometry changed after a frame was taken and before its input (Workflow #392, model 392 v1.2 §6.6): that step sends no input and the next frame is taken. Registered by DA-1; first emitted by DA-3.

display_map_build.description: Building the display map of one frame: its orientation, the layout it is measured on, the scale factor and the scale space (Workflow #392 DA-1).

display_region_map.description: Mapping a region of a task package into the scale frame (Workflow #392 DA-1).

display_input_map.description: Mapping an input box or point of a task package to the device frame (Workflow #392 DA-1).
